headline: Argentina's Congress Approves Central Bank Charter Overhaul
summary: Argentina's Congress granted final approval to President Javier Milei's overhaul of the central bank charter, banning temporary advances to the Treasury and restricting primary market debt purchases.
why: Central bank independence and monetary financing restrictions are critical pillars for stabilizing emerging market economies and curbing inflation.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Legislative changes to central bank operations reshape the country's monetary framework.
